protocol:
1. A reagent is transferred using a micropipette into a series of microcentrifuge tubes held in a green tube rack.
2. A second reagent is added to the same microcentrifuge tubes using a larger volume micropipette.
3. The cap of a microcentrifuge tube is closed.
4. A strip of tubes is placed into a mini-centrifuge/vortexer and the lid is closed to spin the samples.
5. The sample tubes are placed into the block of a thermal cycler.
6. The lid of the thermal cycler is closed to initiate the run.
